## Post-publication audit — August 16, 2026

`v0.6.0-experimental` remains a valid historical source checkpoint. Its tag and target commit have not been moved.

Later audit established these narrower truths:

- the release has GitHub-generated source archives but no AXM-created package, checksum, package receipt, or exact-package launch receipt;
- the release workflow reran the discovery and public-surface gates, not the later full aggregate corrective gate;
- the published “one-use confirmation” wording for the Deterministic PR Publisher was too strong: the implementation used a reusable static exact phrase, not a generated, expiring, atomically consumed nonce;
- additional hardening was required for fixed runner files, hardware authority ceilings, compute-root replay, fresh warning verification, receiver-side draft verification, and repository-local Git hooks.

These findings are preserved here rather than hidden or retroactively rewritten. The source corrections and stronger package/release evidence are carried by `v0.6.1-experimental`.
